definition: Existing beyond human memory or recorded history.
author: Herman Melville
quote: Oh, thou foundling fire, thou hermit immemorial, thou too hast thy incommunicable riddle, thy unparticipated grief.
example_sentence: Grandparents have spoilt grandchildren since time immemorial.
